summary: The frozen statement and all seven proof sections are correct. The explicit sum-preserving map has determinant product_j(1+1/sqrt(m_j)); domination and the row norm estimate||H_j||^2<=m_j give the exact unit-ball bound for every feasible barycentric column. Hadamard thus gives the absorption-sensitive volume ratio with no positive-orthant assumption. Irreducibility supplies a strictly substochastic killed-chain power, the nonnegative inverse, and the row-stochastic absorption matrix; multiplying the original inequalities gives the required domination. The stated irreducible star construction attains the universal2^(-|J|) constant. Every term of the defect identity is nonnegative and expands exactly, so the logarithmic and weighted hit-count budgets have the stated signs and constants. For strict off-diagonal positivity, multiple surviving states make every absorption maximum<1; a single surviving state leaves only the root and uniform vector as norm-one feasible points, excluding equality in full dimensionN-1 whenN>=3. Compactness gives a strict maximum. Finally the centroid fan normalizes to this stochastic form, every qualifying source hits at least two rows, and AM-GM on each vertex cap gives the exact d2 and d3 surplus formulas. Empty, full, zero-weight and boundary-contact cases are addressed. No unknown relation between determinant defects and cap excess is invoked.
target_match_explanation: This is an exact stochastic sign-cone capacity and defect-budget theorem, with fixed centroid sign-fan consequences in d2,d3. It does not establish an arbitrary-fan inequality or a universal mixed-integer center, so it does not resolve the locked weak target or full OC.
